work.title: The Life and Death of King John
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 5, Scene 3
scene.title: SCENE III. The same. The Field of Battle.
scene.location: The same. The Field of Battle.

content.text: Alarums. Enter King John and Hubert.

lines.text: How goes the day with us? O, tell me, Hubert.
lines.plainText: How goes the day with us O tell me Hubert

lines.text: Badly, I fear. How fares your majesty?
lines.plainText: Badly I fear How fares your majesty

lines.text: This fever that hath troubled me so long
lines.plainText: This fever that hath troubled me so long

lines.text: Lies heavy on me. O, my heart is sick!
lines.plainText: Lies heavy on me O my heart is sick

lines.text: My lord, your valiant kinsman, Faulconbridge,
lines.plainText: My lord your valiant kinsman Faulconbridge

lines.text: Desires your majesty to leave the field
lines.plainText: Desires your majesty to leave the field

lines.text: And send him word by me which way you go.
lines.plainText: And send him word by me which way you go

lines.text: Tell him, toward Swinstead, to the abbey there.
lines.plainText: Tell him toward Swinstead to the abbey there

lines.text: Be of good comfort; for the great supply
lines.plainText: Be of good comfort for the great supply

lines.text: That was expected by the Dauphin here
lines.plainText: That was expected by the Dauphin here

lines.text: Are wrack'd three nights ago on Goodwin Sands.
lines.plainText: Are wrack'd three nights ago on Goodwin Sands

lines.text: This news was brought to Richard but even now.
lines.plainText: This news was brought to Richard but even now

lines.text: The French fight coldly, and retire themselves.
lines.plainText: The French fight coldly and retire themselves

lines.text: Ay me, this tyrant fever burns me up
lines.plainText: Ay me this tyrant fever burns me up

lines.text: And will not let me welcome this good news.
lines.plainText: And will not let me welcome this good news

lines.text: Set on toward Swinstead. To my litter straight.
lines.plainText: Set on toward Swinstead To my litter straight

lines.text: Weakness possesseth me, and I am faint.
lines.plainText: Weakness possesseth me and I am faint
